answer: Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 55%. Because the gale pair is tracked in the canyon ledger, the shale audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 61 identities means 61 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
